vars.source:
window = nil
  done = false
  Gtk.queue {
    vars = Vars.list.to_a.sort { |a, b| a[0].to_s <=> b[0].to_s }
    textboxes = Array.new
    table = Gtk::Table.new((vars.length + 1), 3)
    vars.each_index { |i|
      label = Gtk::Label.new(vars[i][0].to_s)
      box = Gtk::Box.new(:horizontal)
      box.pack_end(label, :expand => false, :fill => false, :padding => 0)
      table.attach(box, 0, 1, i, (i + 1), Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
      textbox = Gtk::Entry.new
      if vars[i][1].class == String
        textbox.text = vars[i][1]
      else
        textbox.text = "#{vars[i][1].class}: #{vars[i][1].inspect}"
        textbox.editable = false
      end
      table.attach(textbox, 1, 2, i, (i + 1), (Gtk::AttachOptions::EXPAND | Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL), Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
      textboxes[i] = textbox
      delete_button = Gtk::Button.new(:label => "Delete Entry")
      table.attach(delete_button, 2, 3, i, (i + 1), Gtk::AttachOptions::SHRINK, Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
      delete_button.signal_connect('clicked') {
        report_errors {
          label.sensitive = false
          textbox.sensitive = false
          delete_button.sensitive = false
          textboxes[i] = nil
        }
      }
    }
    new_vars = Array.new
    sw = nil
    add_new_row = proc {
      i = new_vars.length
      table.n_rows = table.n_rows + 1
      label = Gtk::Entry.new
      # Placeholder hints are not values; focus must never erase new typing.
      label.placeholder_text = "(new var name)"
      table.attach(label, 0, 1, (table.n_rows - 1), table.n_rows, Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
      textbox = Gtk::Entry.new
      textbox.placeholder_text = "(new var value)"
      textbox.sensitive = false
      table.attach(textbox, 1, 2, (table.n_rows - 1), table.n_rows, (Gtk::AttachOptions::EXPAND | Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL), Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
      new_vars[i] = [label, textbox]
      delete_button = Gtk::Button.new(:label => "Delete Entry")
      delete_button.sensitive = false
      table.attach(delete_button, 2, 3, (table.n_rows - 1), table.n_rows, Gtk::AttachOptions::SHRINK, Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
      label.show
      textbox.show
      delete_button.show
      label.signal_connect('focus-in-event') {
        report_errors {
          unless textbox.sensitive?
            textbox.sensitive = true
            delete_button.sensitive = true
            add_new_row.call
            Thread.new {
              sleep 0.05
              inc = (sw.vadjustment.upper - sw.vadjustment.value - sw.vadjustment.page_size) / 10.0
              10.times { sw.vadjustment.value = sw.vadjustment.value + inc; sleep 0.02 }
              sw.vadjustment.value = (sw.vadjustment.upper - sw.vadjustment.page_size)
            }
          end
        }
      }
      delete_button.signal_connect('clicked') {
        report_errors {
          label.sensitive = false
          textbox.sensitive = false
          delete_button.sensitive = false
          new_vars[i][1] = nil
        }
      }
    }
    add_new_row.call
    vp = Gtk::Viewport.new(nil, nil)
    vp.add(table)
    sw = Gtk::ScrolledWindow.new
    sw.set_policy(:automatic, :always)
    sw.add(vp)
    window = Gtk::Window.new
    window.title = "Lich - #{Char.name}'s Vars"
    window.set_icon(@default_icon)
    # Save while the viewer is attached so current input is submitted before
    # teardown. Closing the host window has the same meaning as Cancel.
    content = Gtk::Box.new(:vertical, 5)
    content.pack_start(sw)
    actions = Gtk::Box.new(:horizontal, 5)
    save_button = Gtk::Button.new(:label => 'Save & Close')
    cancel_button = Gtk::Button.new(:label => 'Cancel')
    actions.pack_start(save_button)
    actions.pack_start(cancel_button)
    content.pack_start(actions, :expand => false)
    window.add(content)
    window.signal_connect('delete_event') { done = true }
    cancel_button.signal_connect('clicked') { done = true }
    save_button.signal_connect('clicked') {
      report_errors {
        modified = new_vars.any? { |v| (v[1] != nil) and v[1].sensitive? }
        unless modified
          vars.each_index { |i| if textboxes[i].nil? or ((vars[i][1].class == String) and (vars[i][1] != textboxes[i].text)); modified = true; break; end }
        end
        if modified
          vars.each_index { |i|
            if textboxes[i].nil?
              Vars[vars[i][0]] = nil
            elsif (vars[i][1].class == String) and (vars[i][1] != textboxes[i].text)
              Vars[vars[i][0]] = textboxes[i].text
            end
          }
          new_vars.each { |var|
            if (var[1] != nil) and var[1].sensitive?
              if var[0].text.empty?
                echo "warning: ignoring new variable with no name"
              elsif Vars.list.keys.include?(var[0].text)
                echo "warning: new variable #{var[0].text} already exists; ignoring"
              else
                Vars[var[0].text] = var[1].text
              end
            end
          }
        end
        done = true
      }
    }
    window.set_default_size((Gdk::Screen.default.width / 2), (Gdk::Screen.default.height / 3))
    window.set_window_position(:center)
    window.show_all
  }
  begin
    wait_until { done }
  ensure
    Gtk.queue { window.destroy }
  end

          # Hooks execute outside the original script thread. Keep GUI work

          done = false

            add_new_char_row = proc {

              # Placeholder hints are not values; focus must never erase new typing.

              label.signal_connect('focus-in-event') {
                report_errors {
                  unless textbox.sensitive?

                    delete_button.sensitive = true
                    add_new_char_row.call
                    Thread.new {
                      sleep 0.05
                      inc = (char_sw.vadjustment.upper - char_sw.vadjustment.value - char_sw.vadjustment.page_size) / 10.0

            char_vp = Gtk::Viewport.new(nil, nil)
            char_vp.add(char_table)
            char_sw = Gtk::ScrolledWindow.new
            char_sw.set_policy(:automatic, :always)
            char_sw.add(char_vp)

            global_aliases = Array.new
            db.execute("SELECT trigger,target FROM global;") do |row|
              global_aliases.push [row[0], row[1]]

              label = Gtk::Label.new(global_aliases[i][0].to_s)
              box = Gtk::Box.new(:horizontal)
              box.pack_end(label, :expand => false, :fill => false, :padding => 0)

              textbox.text = global_aliases[i][1]
              global_table.attach(textbox, 1, 2, i, (i + 1), (Gtk::AttachOptions::EXPAND | Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL), Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
              global_textboxes[i] = textbox

              global_table.attach(delete_button, 2, 3, i, (i + 1), Gtk::AttachOptions::SHRINK, Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
              delete_button.signal_connect('clicked') {
                report_errors {
                  label.sensitive = false
                  textbox.sensitive = false
                  delete_button.sensitive = false
                  global_textboxes[i] = nil
                }
              }
            }
            new_global_aliases = Array.new
            global_sw = nil
            add_new_global_row = proc {
              i = new_global_aliases.length
              global_table.n_rows = global_table.n_rows + 1
              label = Gtk::Entry.new
              # Placeholder hints are not values; focus must never erase new typing.
              label.placeholder_text = "(new alias trigger)"
              global_table.attach(label, 0, 1, (global_table.n_rows - 1), global_table.n_rows, Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
              textbox = Gtk::Entry.new
              textbox.placeholder_text = "(new alias target)"
              textbox.sensitive = false
              global_table.attach(textbox, 1, 2, (global_table.n_rows - 1), global_table.n_rows, (Gtk::AttachOptions::EXPAND | Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL), Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
              new_global_aliases[i] = [label, textbox]
              delete_button = Gtk::Button.new(:label => "Delete Entry")
              delete_button.sensitive = false
              global_table.attach(delete_button, 2, 3, (global_table.n_rows - 1), global_table.n_rows, Gtk::AttachOptions::SHRINK, Gtk::AttachOptions::FILL, 3, 3)
              label.show
              textbox.show
              delete_button.show
              label.signal_connect('focus-in-event') {
                report_errors {
                  unless textbox.sensitive?
                    textbox.sensitive = true
                    delete_button.sensitive = true
                    add_new_global_row.call
                    Thread.new {
                      sleep 0.05
                      inc = (global_sw.vadjustment.upper - global_sw.vadjustment.value - global_sw.vadjustment.page_size) / 10.0
                      10.times { global_sw.vadjustment.value = global_sw.vadjustment.value + inc; sleep 0.02 }
                      global_sw.vadjustment.value = (global_sw.vadjustment.upper - global_sw.vadjustment.page_size)
                    }
                  end
                }
              }
              delete_button.signal_connect('clicked') {
                report_errors {
                  label.sensitive = false
                  textbox.sensitive = false
                  delete_button.sensitive = false
                  new_global_aliases[i][1] = nil
                }
              }
            }
            add_new_global_row.call

            global_vp = Gtk::Viewport.new(nil, nil)
            global_vp.add(global_table)
            global_sw = Gtk::ScrolledWindow.new
            global_sw.set_policy(:automatic, :always)
            global_sw.add(global_vp)

            # global_tab = Gtk::Box.new(:vertical) # rubocop useless assignment to variable
            notebook = Gtk::Notebook.new
            notebook.append_page(char_sw, Gtk::Label.new("#{Char.name}'s Aliases"))
            notebook.append_page(global_sw, Gtk::Label.new('Global Aliases'))

            $alias_setup_window = Gtk::Window.new
            $alias_setup_window.title = "Lich - Aliases"
            # Commit while the editor is attached; host close is cancellation.
            content = Gtk::Box.new(:vertical, 5)
            content.pack_start(notebook)
            actions = Gtk::Box.new(:horizontal, 5)
            save_button = Gtk::Button.new(:label => 'Save & Close')
            cancel_button = Gtk::Button.new(:label => 'Cancel')
            actions.pack_start(save_button)
            actions.pack_start(cancel_button)
            content.pack_start(actions, :expand => false)
            $alias_setup_window.add(content)
            $alias_setup_window.signal_connect('delete_event') { done = true }
            cancel_button.signal_connect('clicked') { done = true }
            save_button.signal_connect('clicked') {
              report_errors {
                modified = new_char_aliases.any? { |a| (a[1] != nil) and a[1].sensitive? } || new_global_aliases.any? { |a| (a[1] != nil) and a[1].sensitive? }
                unless modified
                  char_aliases.each_index { |i| if char_textboxes[i].nil? or (char_aliases[i][1] != char_textboxes[i].text); modified = true; echo modified; break; end }
                  global_aliases.each_index { |i| if global_textboxes[i].nil? or (global_aliases[i][1] != global_textboxes[i].text); modified = true; echo modified; break; end }
                end
                if modified
                    char_aliases.each_index { |i|
                      if char_textboxes[i].nil?
                        db.execute("DELETE FROM #{character} WHERE trigger=?", [char_aliases[i][0].encode('UTF-8')])
                      elsif (char_aliases[i][1] != char_textboxes[i].text)
                        db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO #{character} (trigger,target) VALUES(?,?);", [char_aliases[i][0].encode('UTF-8'), char_textboxes[i].text.encode('UTF-8')])
                      end
                    }
                    new_char_aliases.each { |a|
                      if (a[1] != nil) and a[1].sensitive?
                        if a[0].text.empty?
                          respond "[alias: warning: ignoring new alias with no trigger]"
                        elsif db.get_first_value("SELECT target FROM #{character} WHERE trigger=? COLLATE NOCASE;", a[0].text.encode('UTF-8'))
                          respond "[alias: warning: new alias #{a[0].text} already exists; ignoring]"
                        else
                          db.execute("INSERT INTO #{character} (trigger,target) VALUES(?,?);", [a[0].text.encode('UTF-8'), a[1].text.encode('UTF-8')])
                        end
                      end
                    }
                    global_aliases.each_index { |i|
                      if global_textboxes[i].nil?
                        db.execute("DELETE FROM global WHERE trigger=?", [global_aliases[i][0].encode('UTF-8')])
                      elsif (global_aliases[i][1] != global_textboxes[i].text)
                        db.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO global (trigger,target) VALUES(?,?);", [global_aliases[i][0].encode('UTF-8'), global_textboxes[i].text.encode('UTF-8')])
                      end
                    }
                    new_global_aliases.each { |a|
                      if (a[1] != nil) and a[1].sensitive?
                        if a[0].text.empty?
                          respond "[alias: warning: ignoring new alias with no trigger]"
                        elsif db.get_first_value("SELECT target FROM global WHERE trigger=? COLLATE NOCASE;", a[0].text.encode('UTF-8'))
                          respond "[alias: warning: new alias #{a[0].text} already exists; ignoring]"
                        else
                          db.execute("INSERT INTO global (trigger,target) VALUES(?,?);", [a[0].text.encode('UTF-8'), a[1].text.encode('UTF-8')])
                        end
                      end
                    }
                    update_regex.call
                end
                done = true
              }
            }

            $alias_setup_window.set_default_size((Gdk::Screen.default.width / 2), (Gdk::Screen.default.height / 3))
            $alias_setup_window.set_window_position(:center)
            $alias_setup_window.set_icon(@default_icon)
            $alias_setup_window.show_all
          }
          begin
            wait_until { done }
          ensure
            Gtk.queue { $alias_setup_window.destroy; $alias_setup_window = nil }
          end
        }

map.source:
module ElanthiaMap
  class MapData
    @data = nil

    class << self
      # Returns the complete map metadata hash
      #
      # Lazy-loads and caches map metadata from room tags on first access.
      # Extracts mapname, mapshortname, and mapcategory tags from rooms.
      #
      # @return [Hash{String => Hash}] Map metadata indexed by normalized filename
      # @option value [String] :name Display name for the map
      # @option value [String] :shortname Short display name
      # @option value [Hash] :categories Category/subcategory relationships
      # @option value [String] :filename Original filename from room data
      def data(rooms: Room)
        return @data if @data

        @data = {}
        rooms.list.each do |room|
          next unless room.image

          key = normalize_key(room.image)
          map = @data[key]

          unless map
            @data[key] = map = {
              name: nil,
              shortname: nil,
              categories: {},
              filename: room.image
            }
          end

          next unless room.tags

          extract_tags(room.tags, map)
        end

        finalize_metadata
        @data
      end

      # Retrieves map metadata for a given filename
      #
      # @param key [String] Map filename (will be normalized)
      # @return [Hash, nil] Map metadata or nil if not found
      def [](key)
        data[normalize_filename(key)]
      end

      # Sets map metadata for a given filename
      #
      # @param key [String] Map filename (will be normalized)
      # @param value [Hash] Map metadata to store
      # @return [Hash] The stored metadata
      def []=(key, value)
        data[normalize_filename(key)] = value
      end

      # Normalizes a filename to a standard format
      #
      # Removes file extension and trailing numbers (e.g., '-1', '-2')
      # and converts to lowercase for consistent lookup.
      #
      # @param filename [String] Filename to normalize
      # @return [String] Normalized filename
      # @example
      #   MapData.normalize_filename('TI-Teras-1.gif') #=> 'ti-teras'
      def normalize_filename(filename)
        filename.gsub(/(-\d+)?\..+$/, '').downcase
      end

      private

      # Normalizes a map key from room data
      # @param image [String] The image filename from room data
      # @return [String] Normalized key
      def normalize_key(image)
        key = image
        key = ::Regexp.last_match(1) if key =~ /^(.+)\.[^.]*$/
        key = ::Regexp.last_match(1) if key =~ /^(.+)-\d+$/
        key
      end

      # Extracts metadata tags from room tags
      # @param tags [Array<String>] Room tags to process
      # @param map [Hash] Map metadata hash to update
      # @return [void]
      def extract_tags(tags, map)
        return unless tags

        tags.each do |tag|
          next unless tag.is_a?(String)

          case tag
          when /^meta:mapname:(.*)$/
            map[:name] ||= ::Regexp.last_match(1)
          when /^meta:mapshortname:(.*)$/
            map[:shortname] ||= ::Regexp.last_match(1)
          when /^meta:mapcategory:(.*?)(?::(.*))?$/
            map[:categories][::Regexp.last_match(1)] = ::Regexp.last_match(2)
          end
        end
      end

      # Finalizes metadata by filling in defaults
      # @return [void]
      def finalize_metadata
        @data.each do |key, map|
          map[:name] ||= key
          shortname = (map[:shortname] ||= map[:name])
          map[:categories].each_key { |k| map[:categories][k] ||= shortname }
        end
      end
    end

    # Map link definitions for navigation between maps
    # Format: [source_map, x1, x2, y1, y2, target_map, target_x, target_y]
    MAP_LINKS = [
      ['TI-teras.gif', 1962, 2238, 68, 192, 'TI-wilds.gif', 840, 1252],
      ['TI-teras.gif', 710, 972, 2130, 2260, 'WL-wehnimers.gif', 2338, 1070],
      ['TI-wilds.gif', 1124, 1412, 604, 682, 'TI-vtull.gif', 2276, 1638],
      ['TI-wilds.gif', 678, 1006, 1218, 1296, 'TI-teras.gif', 2100, 130],
      ['TI-wilds.gif', 1448, 1776, 1386, 1464, 'EN-victory.gif', 660, 1340],
      ['TI-vtull.gif', 2156, 2380, 1556, 1636, 'TI-wilds.gif', 1246, 654],
      ['WL-wehntower.gif', 1448, 1738, 1284, 1414, 'WL-wehnimers.gif', 2182, 464],
      ['WL-wehnimers.gif', 2198, 2314, 364, 480, 'WL-wehntower.gif', 1622, 1332],
      ['WL-wehnimers.gif', 2296, 2380, 1020, 1104, 'TI-teras.gif', 858, 1010],
      ['EN-victory.gif', 548, 724, 1256, 1332, 'TI-wilds.gif', 1634, 1428],
      ['EN-dragonspine.gif', 2038, 2130, 2180, 2272, 'EN-victory.gif', 1654, 218],
      ['EN-victory.gif', 1628, 1720, 144, 236, 'EN-dragonspine.gif', 2092, 2218],
    ].freeze unless defined?(MAP_LINKS)
  end


  # Native map model and controls. Map/file work happens before rendering;
  # transport, callbacks and viewer state remain owned by the core WebUI host.
  class NativeMap
    attr_reader :page
    DEFAULTS = { 'follow_mode' => true, 'keep_centered' => true, 'global_scale' => 1.0,
                 'global_scale_enabled' => false, 'map_scale' => {}, 'dark_mode' => false,
                 'opacity' => 1.0, 'expanded_canvas' => true, 'dynamic_indicator_size' => false,
                 'keep_above' => true, 'borderless' => false, 'hide_scrollbars' => false }.freeze

    # Script.start accepts a command string; the original start_script helper
    # joined its Array arguments before calling it. Preserve the same arguments.
    def initialize(owner:, map_dir:, rooms: Room, settings: Settings, char_settings: (defined?(CharSettings) ? CharSettings : {}), output: nil, notes_path: File.join(DATA_DIR, XMLData.game, 'map_notes.json'),
                   travel: proc { |id| Script.start('go2', "#{id} _disable_confirm_") })
      @owner, @map_dir, @rooms, @store, @notes_path, @travel = owner, File.realpath(map_dir), rooms, settings, notes_path, travel
      @settings_map_dir = map_dir
      @char_store = char_settings
      @output = output || proc { |text| respond text }
      @lock = Monitor.new
      @done = Lich::WebUI::Future.new
      @settings = DEFAULTS.to_h { |key, value| [key, settings[key].nil? ? value : settings[key]] }
      raise ArgumentError, 'Map scale settings must be a mapping of image names to scales' unless @settings['map_scale'].is_a?(Hash)

      @settings['map_scale'] = @settings['map_scale'].dup
      @follow, @fix_mode, @closed = @settings['follow_mode'], false, false
      @message, @active_tag, @active_location = '', '', ''
      @notes = read_notes
      @by_map = rooms.list.select { |room| room.image }.group_by(&:image)
      @catalog = build_catalog
      raise ArgumentError, 'Map catalog exceeds 512 categories; reduce map category tags' if @catalog.size > 512

      @category = @catalog.keys.first
      @temporary_follow = false
      @editors = []
      @editor_sequence = 0
      @file_alias = "map-#{owner.object_id}"
      @file_base = Lich::WebUI.service.register_files(@file_alias, @map_dir, owner: owner, script_root: @map_dir)
      dark = File.join(File.dirname(@map_dir), 'maps-dark')
      if File.directory?(dark)
        @dark_dir = File.realpath(dark)
        @dark_alias = "map-dark-#{owner.object_id}"
        @dark_base = Lich::WebUI.service.register_files(@dark_alias, @dark_dir, owner: owner, script_root: @dark_dir)
      end
    end

    def show
      # Startup arguments are applied before normal following, as in the GTK
      # entrypoint. A requested room without an image must open a blank map.
      update_current if @follow
      map = self
      @page = Lich::WebUI.page(owner: @owner, id: 'map', title: window_title, props: window_props, on: { close: proc { close } }) { |tree| map.send(:render, tree) }
      refresh
      Lich::WebUI.start
      props = window_props
      Lich::WebUI.open(page: @page, geometry: { width: props[:size][0], height: props[:size][1], position: props[:position] })
      self
    rescue StandardError
      close
      raise
    end

    def wait
      @done.await
    ensure
      close
    end

    # Runs on the owning script thread; this observes game changes, not UI events.
    def run
      until @closed
        update_current if @follow
        room_count = $room_count
        sleep 0.2 while room_count == $room_count && !@closed
        sleep 0.1 while !@follow && !@closed
      end
    ensure
      close
    end

    def close
      @lock.synchronize do
        return if @closed
        save_settings
        @closed = true
        @fix_corner = nil
      end
      @editors.dup.each { |editor| close_editor(editor) }
      @done.cancel
      Lich::WebUI.close(@page) if @page
      Lich::WebUI.service.file_service.unregister(@file_alias, owner: @owner)
      Lich::WebUI.service.file_service.unregister(@dark_alias, owner: @owner) if @dark_alias
      nil
    end

    # Startup lookup and the Find dialog originally have different failure
    # messages and follow behavior; keep those distinctions in the native UI.
    def find_room(text, startup: false)
      begin
        room = @rooms[text.to_s]
      rescue StandardError => error
        @output.call(startup ? "[map: Error finding room '#{text}': #{error.message}]" : "[map: Error searching for room: #{error.message}]")
        room = nil
      end
      if startup
        return unless room
        @follow = false
        @temporary_follow = true
        return unless room.image
      elsif !room&.image
        @output.call(room ? '[map: that room does not have an image associated with it]' : '[map: no matching room]')
        return
      end
      @follow = false
      @temporary_follow = true
      @fake_room = room unless startup
      @find_id = room.id
      change_map(room.image)
    end

    # Coordinates arrive in displayed pixels. Undo only presentation's scale
    # and expanded-canvas offset before the original hit testing and actions.
    def click(payload)
      act do
        offset_x, offset_y = map_offset
        x, y = payload.values_at(:x, :y).zip([offset_x, offset_y]).map { |pixel, offset| (pixel - offset) / effective_scale }
        modifiers = payload[:modifiers]
        if payload[:button] == 'secondary'
          @note_id = room_at(x, y)&.id
        elsif modifiers.include?('ctrl') && modifiers.include?('shift') && @fix_mode
          fix_click(x, y)
        elsif modifiers.include?('ctrl')
          @output.call("x: #{x.round}, y: #{y.round}")
        elsif modifiers.include?('shift')
          room = room_at(x, y)
          if room
            @output.call(''); @output.call(room); @output.call('')
          else
            @output.call('[map: no matching room found]')
          end
        elsif (link = MapData::MAP_LINKS.find { |entry| entry[0] == @map && x.between?(entry[1], entry[2]) && y.between?(entry[3], entry[4]) })
          change_map(link[5])
          dx, dy = map_offset
          @scroll_origin = [(link[6] * effective_scale + dx).round, (link[7] * effective_scale + dy).round]
        elsif (room = room_at(x, y))
          @travel.call(room.id)
        else
          @output.call('[map: no matching room found]')
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def act
      @lock.synchronize { yield unless @closed }
    rescue StandardError => error
      @message = error.message.to_s[0, 8192]
      @output.call("[map: #{@message}]")
    ensure
      refresh
    end

    def refresh
      if @page && !@closed
        @page.refresh_definition(title: window_title, props: window_props, on: { close: proc { close } })
        Lich::WebUI.refresh(@page)
      end
    end

    def update_current
      @lock.synchronize do
        current = @rooms.current
        signature = current && [current.id, current.image, coordinates(current)]
        return if @current_signature == signature
        @current_signature = signature
        @current_id = current&.id
        @find_id = nil
        @fake_room = nil
        change_map(current.image) if current&.image && current.image != @map
      end
      refresh
    end

    # Metadata parsing and marker selection reuse the existing map script's
    # tags, image_coords/map_x fallback and fixed map-link definitions.
    def build_catalog
      catalog = Hash.new { |hash, key| hash[key] = [] }
      all = MapData.data(rooms: @rooms).values.sort_by { |map| (map[:name] || '').downcase }
      categories = all.flat_map { |map| map[:categories].keys }.uniq.sort_by(&:downcase)
      categories.each do |category|
        all.select { |map| map[:categories].key?(category) }.sort_by { |map| (map[:shortname] || map[:name] || '').downcase }.each do |map|
          catalog[category] << [map[:shortname] || map[:name] || map[:filename], map[:filename]]
        end
      end
      all.each { |map| catalog['All Maps'] << [map[:shortname] || map[:name] || map[:filename], map[:filename]] }
      all.select { |map| map[:categories].empty? }.sort_by { |map| (map[:shortname] || map[:name] || '').downcase }.each do |map|
        catalog['Uncategorized Maps'] << [map[:shortname] || map[:name] || map[:filename], map[:filename]]
      end
      catalog
    end

    def change_map(filename)
      @map = filename
      @fix_corner = nil
      @scroll_origin = nil
      dark = @settings['dark_mode'] && @dark_dir && File.file?(File.join(@dark_dir, filename))
      root, base = dark ? [@dark_dir, @dark_base] : [@map_dir, @file_base]
      file = File.realpath(File.join(root, filename))
      raise ArgumentError, 'Map image is outside its map directory' unless file.start_with?(root + File::SEPARATOR)
      @dimensions = Lich::WebUI::ImageSize.read(file)
      @image_src = base + URI.encode_www_form_component(filename).gsub('+', '%20')
      @category = @catalog.find { |_key, choices| choices.any? { |_label, value| value == filename } }&.first || @category
      @tag_choices = Array(@by_map[@map]).flat_map { |room| Array(room.tags) }.grep(String).uniq.sort_by(&:downcase)
      @location_choices = Array(@by_map[@map]).map(&:location).reject { |value| value.nil? || value == false }.map(&:to_s).uniq.sort_by(&:downcase)
    rescue StandardError => error
      @image_src = nil
      @message = "Cannot display #{filename}: #{error.message}"[0, 8192]
    end

    def coordinates(room)
      return room.image_coords if room&.image_coords
      return unless room&.respond_to?(:map_x) && room.map_x && room.respond_to?(:map_y) && room.map_y
      radius = room.respond_to?(:map_roomsize) && room.map_roomsize ? room.map_roomsize : 5
      [room.map_x - radius, room.map_y - radius, room.map_x + radius, room.map_y + radius]
    end

    def room_at(x, y)
      Array(@by_map[@map]).find { |room| (box = coordinates(room)) && x.between?(box[0], box[2]) && y.between?(box[1], box[3]) }
    end

    # Retain the original full-path scale keys. A basename entry from the
    # earlier native conversion is only a fallback; it never hides GTK settings.
    def effective_scale
      value = @settings['global_scale_enabled'] ? @settings['global_scale'] :
        @settings['map_scale'].fetch(File.join(@settings_map_dir, @map.to_s)) { @settings['map_scale'].fetch(@map, @settings['global_scale']) }
      value.to_f
    end

    def map_offset
      return [0, 0] unless @dimensions && @settings['expanded_canvas']
      @dimensions.map { |dimension| (dimension * effective_scale).to_i / 2 }
    end

    # Match GTK's physical marker sizes; only the map and room coordinates scale.
    def layers
      scale = effective_scale
      width, height = @dimensions.map { |dimension| [(dimension * scale).to_i, 1].max }
      dx, dy = map_offset
      result = [{ kind: :image, src: @image_src, x: dx, y: dy, w: width, h: height },
                { kind: :region, key: 'map-center', x1: dx + width / 2, y1: dy + height / 2, x2: dx + width / 2 + 1, y2: dy + height / 2 + 1 }]
      display_id = @find_id || @current_id
      Array(@by_map[@map]).sort_by { |room| room.id == display_id ? 0 : 1 }.each do |room|
        next unless (box = coordinates(room))
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = box
        x, y = (x1 * scale).to_i + dx, (y1 * scale).to_i + dy
        w, h = [((x2 - x1) * scale).to_i, 10].max, [((y2 - y1) * scale).to_i, 10].max
        if room.id == display_id
          if @settings['dynamic_indicator_size']
            boost = scale < 1 ? 1 + ((1 - scale) * 4) : 1
            mw, mh = [((x2 - x1) * scale * boost).to_i, 10].max, [((y2 - y1) * scale * boost).to_i, 10].max
          else
            mw = mh = 58
          end
          cx, cy = (((x1 + x2) / 2.0) * scale).to_i + dx, (((y1 + y2) / 2.0) * scale).to_i + dy
          result << { kind: :region, key: 'current', x1: cx, y1: cy, x2: cx + 1, y2: cy + 1 }
          # GTK's original Cairo buffer is premultiplied before Pixbuf blends
          # it again. Preserve the displayed red (214 on white), not pure red.
          result << { kind: :marker, shape: :ring, x: cx - mw / 2, y: cy - mh / 2, w: mw, h: mh,
                      line_width: [[([mw, mh].min / 2.0) * 0.2, 2].max, 8].min, color: { r: 204, g: 0, b: 0, a: 0.8 } }
        end
        if !@active_tag.to_s.empty? && Array(room.tags).include?(@active_tag)
          result << { kind: :marker, shape: :cross, x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h, color: { r: 0, g: 0, b: 204, a: 0.8 } }
        end
        if !@active_location.to_s.empty? && room.location.to_s == @active_location
          result << { kind: :marker, shape: :cross, x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h, color: { r: 0, g: 204, b: 0, a: 0.8 } }
        end
        if @notes.key?(room.id.to_s)
          result << { kind: :region, key: "note-#{room.id}", x1: x, y1: y, x2: x + w, y2: y + h, label: @notes[room.id.to_s][0, 256] }
          result << { kind: :label, x: x + w - 10, y: y - 10, text: 'Note', font_size: 24 }
        end
      end
      result
    end

    def render(tree)
      map = self
      @lock.synchronize do
        tree.presentation(opacity: @settings['opacity'], always_on_top: @settings['keep_above'], borderless: @settings['borderless'])
        tree.scroll(key: 'viewport', fill: true, scrollbars: !@settings['hide_scrollbars'], on: { scrolled: proc {} }) do
          if map.instance_variable_get(:@image_src)
            dimensions = map.instance_variable_get(:@dimensions)
            settings = map.instance_variable_get(:@settings)
            scale = map.send(:effective_scale)
            width, height = dimensions.map { |size| [(size * scale * (settings['expanded_canvas'] ? 2 : 1)).to_i, 65_536].min }
            surface_layers = map.send(:layers)
            center = settings['keep_centered'] && surface_layers.any? { |layer| layer[:key] == 'current' }
            origin = map.instance_variable_get(:@scroll_origin)
            # Split large note/tag overlays across bounded composites without
            # dropping rooms. All layers share one coordinate system and hit test.
            overlay(key: 'map-layers') do
              surface_layers.each_slice(512).with_index do |chunk, index|
                composite(key: "image-#{index}", width: width, height: height, layers: chunk,
                          **(origin ? { scroll_origin: origin } : index.zero? && (center || settings['expanded_canvas']) ? { scroll_to: center ? 'current' : 'map-center' } : {}),
                          context_menu: 'map-options', surface_events: true,
                          on: { surface_activate: proc { |event| map.click(event.payload) },
                                zoom: proc { |event| map.send(:act) { map.send(:change_scale, scale * (event.payload[:direction] == 'in' ? 1.1 : 0.9)) } } })
              end
            end
          else
            # Keep the original options menu reachable in an unmapped room.
            composite(key: 'empty-map', width: 400, height: 300, layers: [], context_menu: 'map-options', surface_events: true,
                      on: { surface_activate: proc { |event| map.click(event.payload) } })
          end
        end
        render_menu(tree)
      end
    end

    # This is the original context-menu hierarchy and immediate toggle behavior.
    # Preferences are written on exit, not through an invented Apply workflow.
    def render_menu(tree)
      map = self
      tree.group(key: 'map-options', label: 'Map options', menu: :context) do
        map.send(:menu_toggle, self, 'Follow', map.instance_variable_get(:@follow), 'follow') do |checked|
          @follow = checked; @temporary_follow = false; @current_signature = nil if checked
        end
        [['Keep Centered', 'keep_centered'], ['Expanded Canvas', 'expanded_canvas'],
         ['Keep window on top', 'keep_above'], ['Dark Mode', 'dark_mode']].each do |label, setting|
          map.send(:setting_toggle, self, label, setting)
        end
        group(key: 'opacity', label: 'Opacity', menu: :submenu) do
          (1..10).each { |n| map.send(:menu_action, self, "#{n * 10}%", "opacity-#{n}", checked: map.instance_variable_get(:@settings)['opacity'] == n / 10.0) { @settings['opacity'] = n / 10.0 } }
        end
        group(key: 'scale', label: 'Scale', menu: :submenu) do
          map.send(:setting_toggle, self, 'Global Scale', 'global_scale_enabled')
          divider
          [0.10, 0.25, 0.33, 0.50, 0.66, 0.75, 0.90, 1.0, 1.10, 1.25, 1.33, 1.50, 1.66, 1.75, 1.90, 2.0].each_with_index do |value, index|
            map.send(:menu_action, self, "#{(value * 100).to_i}%", "scale-#{index}", checked: map.send(:effective_scale) == value) { change_scale(value) }
          end
        end
        group(key: 'maps', label: 'Maps', menu: :submenu) do
          map.instance_variable_get(:@catalog).each_with_index do |(category, choices), index|
            group(key: "category-#{index}", label: category, menu: :submenu) do
              choices.each_with_index do |(label, filename), choice|
                map.send(:menu_action, self, label, "map-#{index}-#{choice}") { change_map(filename) }
              end
            end
          end
        end
        [['Tags', 'tag', :@tag_choices, :@active_tag], ['Locations', 'location', :@location_choices, :@active_location]].each do |label, key, choices_var, active_var|
          group(key: key, label: label, menu: :submenu) do
            map.send(:menu_action, self, "Clear #{key.capitalize} Markers", "clear-#{key}") { instance_variable_set(active_var, nil) }
            divider
            Array(map.instance_variable_get(choices_var)).each_with_index do |value, index|
              map.send(:menu_action, self, value, "#{key}-#{index}") { instance_variable_set(active_var, value) }
            end
          end
        end
        map.send(:menu_action, self, 'Find room...', 'find') { open_find }
        [['Borderless Window', 'borderless'], ['Hide Scrollbars', 'hide_scrollbars'], ['Dynamic Indicator Size', 'dynamic_indicator_size']].each do |label, setting|
          map.send(:setting_toggle, self, label, setting)
        end
        divider
        map.send(:menu_action, self, 'Add/Edit Note', 'note') do
          @note_id ? open_note(@note_id) : @output.call('[map notes: no room found at click position]')
        end
      end
    end

    def menu_action(tree, label, key, checked: nil, &action)
      tree.button(key: key, label: label, **(checked.nil? ? {} : { indicator: :radio, checked: checked }), on: { activate: proc { act { instance_exec(&action) } } })
    end

    def menu_toggle(tree, label, checked, key, &action)
      tree.button(key: key, label: label, indicator: :check, checked: checked == true,
                  on: { activate: proc { act { instance_exec(checked != true, &action) } } })
    end

    def setting_toggle(tree, label, setting)
      presentation_property = { 'keep_above' => :always_on_top, 'borderless' => :borderless }[setting]
      if presentation_property && !@page.presentation_support[presentation_property]
        tree.button(key: setting, label: label, indicator: :check, checked: @settings[setting] == true,
                    disabled: true, tooltip: 'The browser host cannot apply this window setting. Your saved preference is retained.')
        return
      end
      menu_toggle(tree, label, @settings[setting], setting) do |checked|
        @settings[setting] = checked
        change_map(@map) if @map && %w[dark_mode expanded_canvas global_scale_enabled].include?(setting)
      end
    end

    def change_scale(value)
      value = [[value, 0.1].max, 10.0].min
      if @settings['global_scale_enabled']
        @settings['global_scale'] = value
      elsif @map
        @settings['map_scale'][File.join(@settings_map_dir, @map)] = value
      end
    end

    # Original Find and Note editors are separate, nonmodal windows. Give each
    # its own native page/window so editing a note never blocks map navigation.
    def open_editor(kind, title, size, &content)
      @editor_sequence += 1
      map = self
      editor = Lich::WebUI.page(owner: @owner, id: "#{kind}-#{@editor_sequence}", title: title,
        props: { bare: true, theme: :light, density: :compact, size: size },
        on: { close: proc { close_editor(editor) } }) { |tree| content.call(tree, proc { map.send(:close_editor, editor) }) }
      @editors << editor
      Lich::WebUI.refresh(editor)
      Lich::WebUI.open(page: editor)
      editor
    rescue StandardError
      close_editor(editor) if editor
      raise
    end

    def close_editor(editor)
      @editors.delete(editor)
      Lich::WebUI.close(editor)
    end

    def open_find
      map = self
      open_editor('find', 'Find Room', [300, 32]) do |tree, close|
        tree.columns(count: 2, weights: [4, 1], compact: true, gap: 4, margin: 2) do
          entry = text_input(key: 'find-room', value: '', slot: '0')
          find = button(key: 'find-submit', label: 'Find', slot: '1', submit: [entry], on: { activate: proc { |event|
            map.send(:act) { map.find_room(event.submission[entry.cid]) }
            close.call
          } })
          accelerators([{ keys: 'enter', target: find.cid, event: 'activate' }])
          focus(entry.cid)
        end
      end
    end

    def open_note(room_id)
      map = self
      id = room_id.to_s
      notes = read_notes
      open_editor('note', "Note: Room #{id}", [340, 220]) do |tree, close|
        tree.stack(gap: 8, margin: 10) do
          text(content: "Room #{id}", emphasis: :strong, align: :start)
          entry = textarea(key: "note-#{id}", value: notes.fetch(id, ''), rows: 6)
          grid(cols: 3, gap: 6) do
            button(key: 'note-save', label: 'Save', submit: [entry], on: { activate: proc { |event|
              map.send(:save_note, notes, id, event.submission[entry.cid]); close.call
            } })
            button(key: 'note-delete', label: 'Delete Note', on: { activate: proc {
              map.send(:save_note, notes, id, '', deleted: true); close.call
            } })
            button(key: 'note-cancel', label: 'Cancel', on: { activate: close })
          end
        end
      end
    end

    # Preserve the original editor snapshot, trim behavior, messages and failure
    # handling. No new merge policy or settings validation belongs in this UI.
    def save_note(notes, id, text, deleted: false)
      text = text.to_s.strip
      text.empty? ? notes.delete(id) : notes[id] = text
      File.write(@notes_path, JSON.generate(notes))
      @notes = read_notes
      @output.call("[map notes: #{deleted ? 'deleted' : 'saved'} for room #{id}]")
      refresh
    rescue StandardError => error
      @output.call("[map notes: error saving - #{error.message}]")
    end

    def window_title
      character = defined?(Char) ? Char.name : ''
      id = @find_id || @current_id
      "Map: #{character}#{id ? " (##{id})" : ''}"
    end

    def window_props
      { bare: true, theme: :light, density: :compact, viewport: true,
        size: [@char_store['window_width'] || 400, @char_store['window_height'] || 300],
        position: @char_store['window_position'] || [0, 0] }
    end

    def save_settings
      if (geometry = @page&.window_geometry) && geometry[:width].positive? && geometry[:height].positive?
        @char_store['window_width'], @char_store['window_height'] = geometry.values_at(:width, :height)
        @char_store['window_position'] = geometry[:position]
        @char_store.save if @char_store.respond_to?(:save)
      end
      @settings['follow_mode'] = @follow unless @temporary_follow
      @settings.each { |key, value| @store[key] = value }
      @store.save
      if @trouble_mode
        @output.call('[map: === SAVING SETTINGS ===]')
        @output.call("[map: Captured window geometry: #{@page&.window_geometry.inspect}]")
        @output.call("[map: Global Settings: #{@settings.inspect}]")
        @output.call('[map: === END SAVING SETTINGS ===]')
      end
    end

    def read_notes
      File.exist?(@notes_path) ? JSON.parse(File.read(@notes_path)) : {}
    rescue StandardError
      {}
    end

    def fix_click(x, y)
      if @fix_corner
        first = @fix_corner
        center_x, center_y = ((x + first[:x]) / 2).round, ((y + first[:y]) / 2).round
        size = (((x - first[:x]).abs + (y - first[:y]).abs) / 2).round
        current = @fake_room || @rooms.current
        @output.call("#{current.id}; x: #{center_x}, y: #{center_y}, size: #{size}")
        current.image = File.basename(@map)
        current.image_coords = [[first[:x].round, x.round].min, [first[:y].round, y.round].min,
                                [first[:x].round, x.round].max, [first[:y].round, y.round].max]
        @fix_corner = nil
        @by_map = @rooms.list.select { |room| room.image }.group_by(&:image)
        @output.call('[map fix: Room coordinates set.]')
      else
        @fix_corner = { x: x, y: y }
        @output.call("[map fix: First corner set at (#{x.round}, #{y.round}). Click second corner.]")
      end
    end

  end
